definition-changed.answer: 2002 'alphanumeric group item: Any group item except for' a strongly-typed, a bit and a national group (§2002:4); 2023 also excludes the variable-length group, a 2023-only construct, so SR1 b governs the same 2002 records. Bit refused and national admitted at 2002 (the read's probes); a strongly-typed second record refused COBOL1994 at 2002 by probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out-answer/probes-a-05/read-into-strong-rec.cob, its untyped control accepted.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd) changes only a sequential READ PREVIOUS that is the first retrieval after OPEN on an indexed file, the case of §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c; this rule does not govern that case, and its own behaviour at --std 2002 is shown by its compile-time probes at 2002 (read-sr1-BIT.cob, read-sr1-NATIONAL.cob, w-pb337-read-into-not-admissible.cob) and probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out-answer/probes-a-05/read-into-strong-rec.cob (COBOL1994 at 2002; control accepted); a syntax rule the run-time switch cannot reach. Separately, the switch's own 2002 arm is wrong (a defect lead, not this row's): probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out-answer/probes-a-05/read-prev-open-2002.cob gives P1=K002|00 at --std 2002 (and 2014), where §2002:14.8.26.3 GR12 sets an indexed file's position indicator to the lowest-ordinal characters and §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c selects a record whose key is 'less than or equal to the file position indicator', none, so GR18 gives status 10 and the at end condition (2023 prints ATEND|10); code site IndexedConnector.SelectSequentialRecord (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/IndexedConnector.cs:445) with DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd (DialectBehavior.cs:297, kb/Work PB344).
